mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate level indicates monetary easing conditions.
failure_condition: Win rate (proportion of 20-day returns positive when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) is less than 40% in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the prior 3 months signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 6-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate for positive 20-day returns when both series exceed 6-month averages is less than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months), higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity supporting corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the series reflects current economic momentum.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as predictor of 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate (proportion of 60-day returns positive when INDPRO > 115) is less than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 over the prior 3 months signals healthy labor market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises > 100k in 3 months, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strong economy with monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or win rate for negative 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls is less than 40%.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market downturn (HOUST falling below 1.7 million units over the prior 3 months), reduced consumer spending and investment cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when HOUST falls below 1700k in 3 months, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
